title: Your briefing: an independent test of Lumen-4 and new AI-tutoring guidance

content.title: Your briefing: an independent test of Lumen-4 and new AI-tutoring guidance
content.intro: Two developments matched your interests since your last briefing: an independent benchmark of a math-tutoring model, and state guidance for schools using AI tutors.

items.headline: Independent test finds Lumen-4 solves 61% of held-out problems, below the company's 82% figure
items.what_changed: An independent evaluation of 1,200 held-out problems reported 61% accuracy; Lumen Labs' launch materials claimed 82% on competition problems.
items.why_it_matters: Schools weighing AI math tutors now have third-party evidence alongside the vendor's own figure; the two used different problem sets.

items.headline: Tutoring <script>alert('x')</script> & "quotes" are escaped
items.what_changed: A source with an unsafe link scheme is listed without a link.
items.why_it_matters: Readers should never receive executable markup or javascript: links.

items.headline: State issues draft guidance on AI tutors in classrooms
items.what_changed: The draft asks districts to review evidence of learning outcomes before adopting AI tutors.
items.why_it_matters: It applies to public schools from the 2027 school year if adopted; the comment period is still open.

content.closing_note: Nothing else you follow changed materially. We will write again when something does.
